_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Notification of Shipment of Repaired Government Materiel
summary: The notification provides shipment verification for repaired materiel returned to the Government and helps assure continuity of the property accountability audit trail.
description_purpose:
3.1 The notification provides shipment verification for repaired materiel being returned to the Government.

3.2 This notification enables the Government to verify shipment of repaired Government materiel and assure continuity of property accountability audit trail.
application_interrelationship:
7.1 This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement for this data included in the contract.

7.2 This DID is applicable to all contracts for repair of Government materiel.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The format shall be 80 column Electronic Accounting Machine (EAM) cards.

children.title: Item 1 - DOCUMENT IDENTIFIER CODE (CC 1-3).
children.content: Code which identifies the purpose of this transaction and the system to which it pertains. Constant "BZD".

children.title: Item 2 - ROUTING IDENTIFIER CODE (CC 4-6).
children.content: Routing Identifier Code (RIC) identifying the address of the Accountable Supply Distribution Activity (ASDA) to which this document shall be forwarded. To be specified in the contract.

children.title: Item 4 - NATIONAL STOCK NUMBER (CC 8-22).
children.content: 13-digit NSN of the item being shipped. Do not zero fill.

children.title: Item 5 - UNIT OF ISSUE (CC 23-24).
children.content: The 2-position alphabetic abbreviation expressing a determinate quantity of an item that will be issued by which accountable records are maintained. To be specified on original shipping document.

children.title: Item 6 - QUANTITY (CC 25-29).
children.content: Enter the quantity shipped. Right justified. Zero filled (e.g., 00010).

children.title: Item 7 - DOCUMENT NUMBER (CC 30-43).
children.content: Enter the document number under which this item was received.

children.title: Item 8 - SUFFIX CODE (CC 44).
children.content: When a partial quantity is shipped, it shall be documented by assignment of a sequential suffix code which relates and identifies this shipment to the original document. A-Z and 2-9 may be utilized, excluding I, N, O, P, R, S, Y, or Z (e.g., W52H097060H226A).

children.title: Item 9 - DOD ACTIVITY ADDRESS CODE (CC 45-50).
children.content: Assigned 6-position Department of Defense activity address code (DODAAC) specified in the contract which authorizes the contractor to receive or ship Government materiel. To be specified in the contract.

children.title: Item 10 - SIGNAL CODE (CC 51).
children.content: Constant "H" designates the field containing DODAAC of the shipping activity.

children.title: Item 11 - FUND CODE (CC 52-53).
children.content: Code specifying that transaction is nonreimbursable. Constant "GM".

children.title: Item 13 - DATE SHIPPED (CC 57-59).
children.content: Enter the Julian day the materiel is shipped. Example: 1 Jan shall be written as 001; 31 Dec as 365.

children.title: Item 15 - BILL NUMBER (CC 62-76).
children.content: Enter the appropriate Transportation Control Number (TCN) or other transportation number of the shipment. Left justified. May contain blanks (e.g., 2501R70136134XX).

children.title: Item 16 - MODE OF SHIPMENT (CC 77).
children.content:
Enter appropriate code from the following:
A Motor, truckload
B Motor, less than truckload
C Van (unpacked, uncrated personal or Government property)
D Driveaway, truckaway, towaway
E Bus
F Military Airlift Command (MAC)
G Surface parcel post
H Air parcel post
I Government trucks, for shipment outside local delivery area
J Small package
K Rail, carload (includes trailer or container-on-flat-car (excluding SEAVAN))
L Rail, less than carload (includes trailer or container-on-flat-car (excluding SEAVAN))
M Freight forwarder
N Long Term Contract Airlift Service within CONUS (LOGAIR) (Army and Air Force)
O Organic military air (including aircraft of foreign Government)
P Through Government Bill of Lading (TGBL)
Q Air freight, air express, air charter (commercial)
R Expedited air freight
S Scheduled truck service (applies to contract carriage, guaranteed traffic routings and scheduled service)
T Air freight forwarder
U Long Term Contract Airlift Service within CONUS (QUICKTRANS) (Navy and Marine Corps)
V Commercial or Government-owned (or leased) shipping container (SEAVAN)
W Water, river, lake, coastal (commercial)
X Bearer walk-though (customer pickup of materiel)
Y Intratheater airlift service
Z Major subordinate command (MSC) (controlled contract or arranged space)
2 Government watercraft, barge, lighter
3 Roll on or roll off (RORO) service
4 Armed Forces Courier Service (ARFCOS)
5 United Parcel Service
6 Military official mail (MOM)
7 Express mail
8 Pipeline
9 Local delivery by Government or commercial truck, includes on-base transfers, deliveries between air, water, or motor terminals, and adjacent activities. Local delivery areas are identified in commercial carriers' tariffs which are filed and approved by regulatory authorities.
